toolsPreview.name: scan_url
toolsPreview.description: Run an AgentReady scan of a public URL. Returns the 0-100 score, per-phase findings, top priorities, and the Fix Pack v2 implementation contract. Repository paths remain candidate targets until a connected-repository resolver proves them.

toolsPreview.name: get_fix_pack
toolsPreview.description: Scan a public URL and return Fix Pack v2: prioritized fixes with stable ids, observed evidence, candidate target URLs and repository paths, review gates, and fix-specific acceptance assertions for a coding agent.

toolsPreview.name: verify_fixes
toolsPreview.description: Re-scan a public URL and evaluate fix-specific stable ids from a previous v1 or v2 Fix Pack. A fix closes when its finding id is absent; score delta is secondary evidence only.
